title: Shots after a make and after a miss
intro: Illustrative data, made up for this book: the sizes and patterns are realistic, the teams and players are not real. 400 shots by one basketball player, each classified by what happened on the shot before it. After a make: 104 made, 96 missed. After a miss: 96 made, 104 missed. Is a make more likely after a make?
